// Fixture — realistic extract of src/animation-overrides.ts. The header
// prose and helper below the record MUST survive any apply untouched.
import type { SkeletalState } from './critter-skeletal';

export type ClipOverrideMap = Partial<Record<SkeletalState, unknown>>;

/**
 * Sparse per-critter overrides. Empty map = pure resolver.
 */
export const ANIMATION_OVERRIDES: Record<string, ClipOverrideMap> = {
  sergei: {
    ability_1: { clip: "Ability1", speed: 1.8 },
    ability_2: { clip: "Ability2", speed: 1.5 },
    fall: { clip: "Fall", loop: true },
    run: { clip: "Run", speed: 1.3 }, // exact-match tier already picks Run
    victory: { clip: "Victory", loop: true },
  },

  trunk: {
    ability_1: { clip: "Ability1", speed: 3 },
    // Ground pound doubles as ability_2 — GLB ships no dedicated clip.
    ability_2: "Ability3GroundPound",
    fall: { clip: "Fall", speed: 2, loop: true },
  },

  kermit: {
    victory: { clip: "Victory", loop: true },
    fall: { clip: "Fall", loop: true },
  },
};

/** Helper kept below the record — must survive applies byte-identical. */
export function getClipOverride(id: string): string | null {
  const entry = ANIMATION_OVERRIDES[id];
  return entry ? 'found' : null;
}
